html_title: SEA — Comparative cardiovascular and renal effectiveness of empagliflozin and dapagliflozin: Scandinavian cohort study
source_integrity_findings: Serious renal events for dapagliflozin are reported as 4.1 events/1000 person-years in the abstract and Table 2 but 4.0/1000 in the Results narrative; Table 2 value 4.1 is used for the normalized main-result atom.

Supplementary Tables S8 and S11 show small differences in some Denmark adjusted incidence rates despite identical event counts and arm sizes; the source does not explain whether rates were recomputed.
